unitTitle: The Python Hunt - Episode 1: Do not Disturb
scanNote:
2-HIKOYA, 1-QISM - MAShQLAR BETI (69-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'The Python Hunt - Episode 1'.

CHAP USTUN:
1) 'Look at the pictures on p. 68, read the sentences and circle the correct answer.' 1 Where is Cameroon? a in America b in Africa. 2 What is a python? a a big snake b a big mouse. 3 Where do pythons live? a inside trees b inside holes in the ground. 4 What is the man covering his arm with in picture 5? a his jacket b animal skin. 5 What is David holding in picture 6? a his camera & a torch b his camera & a lighter.
2) Kasseta belgisi: 'Who said the following? Listen and write S for Sandra, D for David or A for Abou.' 1 'Why do you hunt them?' 2 'They show there's a python inside the hole.' 3 'I want to take pictures of the snake.' 4 'Quick, Sandra! Help me pull him out!'
3) 'Read the episode on p. 68 and answer the questions.' 1 How long has Adamou been hunting pythons? 2 Why do they hunt pythons? 3 What do the marks on the ground show? 4 How do they catch pythons?
4) 'Read the episode again and underline the adjectives which are used to describe pythons. Then, use them to talk about pythons.'
5) 'Fill in the opposites from the list, then make sentences using them.' Qiya: ugly, harmless, weak, blunt. 1 strong ≠ 2 beautiful ≠ 3 sharp ≠ 4 dangerous ≠

O'NG USTUN:
6) 'Complete the puzzle to find Adamou's job.' Krossvord (och ko'k fon, sariq vertikal ustun): 1 Pythons live inside ...... . 2 There are marks on the ...... that show where the python is. 3 Pythons are ...... enough to kill people. 4 Pythons have got long teeth and they ...... . 5 Adamou covers his arm with animal skin, like a ...... . 6 Pythons' teeth are very ...... .
• OCh KO'K quti, oq katta harflar 'too · enough': • 'We use TOO before adjectives or adverbs. It has a negative meaning. Don't get TOO CLOSE to the python.' • 'We use ENOUGH after adjectives or adverbs. It has a positive meaning. Pythons are STRONG ENOUGH to kill you.'
7) 'Fill in ENOUGH or TOO.' 1 It's ...... cold to play in the garden. 2 He isn't old ...... to drive a car. 3 She is tall ...... to reach the top shelf. 4 It's ...... dark in here for me to read. 5 These bags are ...... heavy for me to carry.
8) 'Fill in the missing words, then say how we use these pronouns and adjectives.' JADVAL: Subject Pronouns: I, you, he, she, it, we, you, they | Object Pronouns: me, you, him, ......, it, us, you, ...... | Possessive Adjectives: my, ......, his, her, ......, our, your, their | Possessive Pronouns: mine, yours, ......, hers, -, ours, yours, ......
9) 'Underline the correct word, then say what kind of pronoun or adjective each one is.' 1 He/Him wanted to take pictures of the snake inside it/its hole. 2 Look at them/their! They/Them are flying. 3 He's covering him/his arm with animal skin. 4 Please help me/my pull her/hers out! 5 Our/Ours house is in the suburbs. 6 Ask their/them to help you/your do the exercise.
10) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and follow the episode on p. 68, then read out the episode. What do you think will happen to David?'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '69'.

items.en: 1 How long has Adamou been hunting pythons?
items.uz: 1 Adamou qancha vaqtdan beri piton ovlaydi?
items.answerEn: He has been hunting pythons for thirty years.
items.answerUz: U o'ttiz yildan beri piton ovlaydi.

items.answerEn: They hunt them for their meat and their beautiful skins.
items.answerUz: Ular go'shti va chiroyli terisi uchun ovlaydi.

items.en: 3 What do the marks on the ground show?
items.answerEn: They show that there is a python inside the hole.
items.answerUz: Ular teshik ichida piton borligini ko'rsatadi.

items.answerEn: The hunter covers his arm with animal skin, goes down into the hole and pulls the python out.
items.answerUz: Ovchi qo'lini hayvon terisi bilan o'rab, teshikka tushadi va pitonni tortib chiqaradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the episode again and underline the adjectives which are used to describe pythons. Then, use them to talk about pythons.
exercises.instructionUz: Qismni qayta o'qing va pitonlarni tasvirlashda ishlatilgan sifatlar tagiga chizing. So'ng ular bilan pitonlar haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
PITONLARNI TASVIRLOVChI SIFATLAR:

  dangerous - xavfli
  poisonous - zaharli (inkorda:
     'aren't poisonous')
  big - katta
  strong - kuchli
  beautiful (skins) - chiroyli
  long, sharp (teeth) - uzun, o'tkir


GAPIRISh:
  'Pythons are big and strong. They
   aren't poisonous, but they are
   dangerous. They have got long,
   sharp teeth and beautiful skins.'

points.en: dangerous, poisonous, big, strong, beautiful (skins), long, sharp (teeth)
points.uz: xavfli, zaharli, katta, kuchli, chiroyli (teri), uzun, o'tkir (tishlar)

points.en: Pythons are big and strong. They aren't poisonous, but they are dangerous. They have got long, sharp teeth and beautiful skins.
points.uz: Pitonlar katta va kuchli. Ular zaharli emas, lekin xavfli. Ularning uzun, o'tkir tishlari va chiroyli terisi bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the opposites from the list, then make sentences using them.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan antonimlarni qo'ying, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
ANTONIMLAR:

  strong ≠ WEAK (kuchli ≠ kuchsiz)
  beautiful ≠ UGLY (chiroyli ≠
     xunuk)
  sharp ≠ BLUNT (o'tkir ≠ o'tmas)
  dangerous ≠ HARMLESS (xavfli ≠
     zararsiz)


⚠ 'HARMLESS':

  = zararsiz.
  ⚠ 'harm' (zarar) + '-less' (yo'q).
  ⚠ 'harmful' = zararli.


⚠ 'BLUNT':

  = o'tmas (pichoq).
  ⚠ 'a blunt knife'.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the puzzle to find Adamou's job.
exercises.instructionUz: Adamouning kasbini topish uchun krossvordni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KROSSVORD - JAVOB: HUNTER.

  1 HOLES (H)
  2 GROUND (U)
  3 STRONG (N)
  4 BITE (T)
  5 GLOVE (E)
  6 SHARP (R)

  ⚠ Sariq ustundagi harflar:
  H-U-N-T-E-R = ovchi.

items.textEn: 1 Pythons live inside ___ .
2 There are marks on the ___ that show where the python is.
3 Pythons are ___ enough to kill people.
4 Pythons have got long teeth and they ___ .
5 Adamou covers his arm with animal skin, like a ___ .
6 Pythons' teeth are very ___ .

exercises.explanationUz:
TOO va ENOUGH.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TOO = JUDA (ortiqcha, SALBIY)   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  SIFATDAN OLDIN:
  'too close', 'too cold', 'too
   heavy'

  "Don't get TOO CLOSE to the
   python."
  ⚠ Ma'no: kerakligidan ORTIQ →
  muammo.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ENOUGH = YETARLI (IJOBIY)       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  SIFATDAN KEYIN:
  'strong enough', 'old enough',
  'tall enough'

  'Pythons are STRONG ENOUGH to kill
   you.'
  ⚠ Ma'no: kerakli darajada.


⚠ ENG MUHIM - O'RNI:

  TOO + sifat    (too cold)
  sifat + ENOUGH (cold enough)

  ⚠ 'enough cold' - XATO!
  ⚠ Lekin OTDAN OLDIN: 'enough
  money', 'enough time'.


⚠ 'TOO ... TO' va 'ENOUGH ... TO':

  "It's TOO cold TO play." = juda
     sovuq, o'ynab bo'lmaydi
  "It's warm ENOUGH TO play." =
     o'ynash uchun yetarli iliq


⚠ 'FOR ME':

  'too heavy FOR ME to carry' = men
  ko'tarish uchun juda og'ir.


⚠ 'TOO' va 'VERY':

  very = juda (neytral)
  too = juda (ortiqcha, salbiy)
  'It's VERY hot.' - shunchaki issiq
  'It's TOO hot.' - chidab bo'lmaydi

points.en: We use too before adjectives or adverbs. It has a negative meaning. Don't get too close to the python.
points.uz: 'too' ni sifat yoki ravishdan OLDIN ishlatamiz. Salbiy ma'noga ega. Pitonga juda yaqin borma.

points.en: We use enough after adjectives or adverbs. It has a positive meaning. Pythons are strong enough to kill you.
points.uz: 'enough' ni sifat yoki ravishdan KEYIN ishlatamiz. Ijobiy ma'noga ega. Pitonlar sizni o'ldirishga yetarli kuchli.

exercises.explanationUz:
O'RNIGA QARANG:

  bo'sh joy SIFATDAN OLDIN → too
  bo'sh joy SIFATDAN KEYIN → enough


JAVOBLAR:

  1 It's TOO cold to play in the
    garden.
  2 He isn't old ENOUGH to drive a
    car.
  3 She is tall ENOUGH to reach the
    top shelf.
  4 It's TOO dark in here for me to
    read.
  5 These bags are TOO heavy for me
    to carry.


⚠ 2-BAND - INKOR:

  "isn't old ENOUGH" = yetarli katta
  emas (haydash uchun).


⚠ 'THE TOP SHELF':

  = eng yuqori javon.
  ⚠ 'to reach' = yetmoq (qo'l).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing words, then say how we use these pronouns and adjectives.
exercises.instructionUz: Tushib qolgan so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng bu olmosh va sifatlarni qanday ishlatishimizni ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLMOShLAR JADVALI - TO'LIQ:

  SUBJECT (ega):
    I, you, he, she, it, we, you,
    they
  OBJECT (to'ldiruvchi):
    me, you, him, HER, it, us, you,
    THEM
  POSSESSIVE ADJECTIVES (egalik
  sifati - OT bilan):
    my, YOUR, his, her, ITS, our,
    your, their
  POSSESSIVE PRONOUNS (egalik
  olmoshi - OTSIZ):
    mine, yours, HIS, hers, -, ours,
    yours, THEIRS


⚠ QANDAY IShLATILADI:

  EGA - fe'ldan OLDIN:
    'HE wanted to take pictures.'
  TO'LDIRUVChI - fe'l/predlogdan
  KEYIN:
    'Help ME pull HER out.'
  EGALIK SIFATI - OTDAN OLDIN:
    'HIS arm', 'OUR house'
  EGALIK OLMOShI - OT O'RNIDA:
    'This book is MINE.' (my book)


⚠ 'ITS' va "IT'S":

  its = uning (egalik) - APOSTROFSIZ
  it's = it is / it has
  ⚠ ENG KO'P XATO!


⚠ 'HIS' - IKKI VAZIFADA:

  'his arm' (sifat) va 'This is
  his.' (olmosh) - BIR XIL shakl.


⚠ 'ITS' NING EGALIK OLMOShI YO'Q:

  Jadvalda '-' turibdi.

items.textEn: Object Pronouns: me, you, him, ___, it, us, you, ...
Object Pronouns: ... it, us, you, ___
Possessive Adjectives: my, ___, his, her, ...
Possessive Adjectives: ... his, her, ___, our, your, their
Possessive Pronouns: mine, yours, ___, hers, ...
items.whyUz: ⚠ he → HIS (sifat va olmosh bir xil).

items.textEn: Possessive Pronouns: ... hers, -, ours, yours, ___

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word, then say what kind of pronoun or adjective each one is.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri so'z tagiga chizing, so'ng har biri qanday olmosh yoki sifat ekanini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR VA TURLARI:

  1 HE (ega) ... ITS hole (egalik
    sifati)
  2 Look at THEM (to'ldiruvchi)!
    THEY (ega) are flying.
  3 HIS arm (egalik sifati)
  4 help ME (to'ldiruvchi) pull HER
    (to'ldiruvchi) out
  5 OUR house (egalik sifati)
  6 Ask THEM (to'ldiruvchi) to help
    YOU (to'ldiruvchi)


⚠ TEZ TEKShIRUV:

  Fe'ldan OLDIN → ega (he, they)
  Fe'l/predlogdan KEYIN →
     to'ldiruvchi (me, her, them,
     you)
  OTDAN OLDIN → egalik sifati (its,
     his, our)


⚠ 'THE SUBURBS':

  = shahar chekkasi.

items.en: What do you think will happen to David?
items.answerEn: I think the python will bite David, but Abou and Sandra will pull him out and he will be all right.
items.answerUz: Menimcha, piton Davidni tishlaydi, lekin Abou va Sandra uni tortib chiqarishadi va u sog'-omon bo'ladi.
